cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Water is now the dominant topic. A remarkably accurate forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.

mechanism: Copy a plumber's turning motion without knowing which tap, then reinterpret the promised flowing evening as prediction of each newly disclosed water consequence.
confusable: Not planned failure D233: A claims earlier words predicted the surprises, without needing to say it deliberately caused them.
comparison: Indoor flood and shutoff rather than a rainy holiday and return journey.
seedUse: Retains evening-will-flow/open-up plumbing reinterpretation; adds wrong tap copied from plumber's valve.
